name: Ricoh Company, Ltd.
summary: Ricoh Company, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the digital services, digital products, graphic communications, industrial solutions, and other businesses in Japan, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. The company is involved in the production, OEM, and sale of multifunctional printers (MFPs) laser printers, digital duplicators, wide format printers, facsimile machine, scanners, personal computers, servers, and network equipment; production and sales of electronic components; and provision of related parts and supplies, services, support, software, and service and solutions related to documents.
